function preserveTernary<T>(value: T): T {
  typeof value === "string" ? console.log(value.length) : console.log(String(value));
  return value;
}
function preserveIf<T>(value: T): T {
  if (typeof value === "number") console.log(value + 1);
  else console.log(String(value));
  return value;
}
function preserveInitializer<T>(value: T): T {
  const length = typeof value === "string" ? value.length : 1;
  console.log(length);
  return value;
}
function preserveConstrained<T extends string | number>(value: T): T {
  if (typeof value === "string") console.log(value.length);
  else console.log(value.toFixed(1));
  return value;
}
console.log(preserveTernary("hi"), preserveIf(2), preserveInitializer("four"));
console.log(preserveConstrained("five"), preserveConstrained(6));
